subject: English
passage:
[Figure 1]

Economists Mateo Espinoza and Amina Ozturk were analyzing regional free-trade zones in Southeast Asia when they observed that three of the zones were hosting clusters of small export firms. Additionally, the team found that manufacturing-sector firms and agricultural-sector firms operate within the same zone (the same regulatory environment), a pattern not seen among the special economic corridors of the neighboring subregion.
prompt: Which choice best describes data from the graph that support the underlined claim?

choices.A: Each of the three zones hosted at least one manufacturing-sector firm and at least one agricultural-sector firm.
choices.C: Each of the three zones hosted at least one manufacturing-sector firm and at least one services-sector firm.

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer because it describes data from the graph that support the underlined claim that manufacturing-sector firms and agricultural-sector firms operate within the same zone. The graph shows that Zone 1 hosted 16 manufacturing firms and 12 agricultural firms, Zone 2 hosted 1 manufacturing firm and 2 agricultural firms, and Zone 3 hosted 2 manufacturing firms and 1 agricultural firm. Thus, each of the three zones contained both sector types, demonstrating that manufacturing and agricultural firms share the same regulatory environment.

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect. Although this choice accurately describes data from the graph, it only mentions agricultural-sector firms in Zone 1 and doesn't address whether manufacturing and agricultural firms operate within the same zone, which is the focus of the claim.
